title: Exclude reqforge's own commits from sandbox violations
description: The before/after snapshot in server/src/agent.rs:200-227 compares the requirements repo's git status, so run logs and record updates committed by the server or by parallel runs during a run are reported as violations (seen on RUN-TASK-0046, 0048 and 0050). Compare only changes not made by reqforge's own commits. Tag tests REQ-0052#AC6.
done_when: agent_sandbox tests pass, including two parallel runs where one finishes first and neither is flagged, and a run that edits the requirements repo itself is still flagged.
